overview.description: The Defiance KSM Israel 120 ETF (ISRL) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund tracks an index comprised of the largest Israeli companies by market capitalization. ISRL was launched on Aug 31, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
